name: Ikiru to Iu Koto
source:
What is the meaning of life, really?
What is our purpose - each individual purpose, each individual life - why are we here?
Why do we live, yet, unknowingly, live only in death?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31240]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
生命究竟意味着什么？
我们每个人的目的、每个人的人生究竟是什么？我们为什么会在这里？
为什么我们活着，却在不知不觉间只活在死亡之中？

[摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31240]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
